value.rationale: The original Riccati annulus has an exact half-turn inverse-radius identity. A natural signed second-harmonic cubic perturbation selects a unique global positive cycle. The strictly positive quadratic violation of the axial identity, together with symmetry-protected absence of odd powers, is a nontrivial geometric response not explained by uniqueness, hyperbolicity, or first-order Melnikov alone; the continuum κ∈(0,1) gives a useful structural benchmark for rigid-system perturbation and periodic orbit shape.
